title: I Printed the Whiteboard Photo for the Scrum-of-Scrums Hero Who Moved Nothing

parts.text: I sat the scrum-of-scrums at 9:01 a.m. and the hero talked for six minutes about tickets that had not moved since Tuesday. The board photo policy they posted said: SAY ONLY WHAT THE BOARD SHOWS. I was thirty-one, delivering, holding a phone still of the same three stickies. I printed the still in the hallway plotter and handed it out. The hero sat down. We finished in eleven minutes. The stickies moved after lunch, which is still not six minutes of air. The plotter, it turns out, is a scrum master.

social.video_title: The standup hero had not moved a sticky — Part 1/1
social.description: Six minutes of air, a board photo policy, a hallway plotter. We finished in eleven. Would you have clapped?
